In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

66	
67	\[ \log p_\theta(x \mid y) \;\ge\; \mathbb{E}_{q_\phi(z|x,y)}\big[\log p_\theta(x|y,z)\big] \;-\; D_{KL}\big(q_\phi(z|x,y)\,\|\,p(z)\big) \]

106	**关键代码二：encoder 的条件拼接**（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L212-L223](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L212-L223)），这段代码做了什么：`encoder` 开头两行就是「条件化」——one-hot 后与展平的像素向量沿特征维 cat 成 794 维，其余（隐层→双头→重参数化）与 u5-l3 的 VAE 完全相同：
107	
108	```python
109	def encoder(self, features, targets):
110	    ### Add condition
111	    onehot_targets = to_onehot(targets, self.num_classes, device)
112	    x = torch.cat((features, onehot_targets), dim=1)   # [N,784] + [N,10] → [N,794]
113	    x = F.leaky_relu(self.hidden_1(x))
114	    z_mean = self.z_mean(x)
115	    z_log_var = self.z_log_var(x)
116	    encoded = self.reparameterize(z_mean, z_log_var)
117	    return z_mean, z_log_var, encoded
118	```
119	
120	对应地，第一层的输入维度在 `__init__` 里就是 `num_features+num_classes`（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L188](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L188)）：`torch.nn.Linear(num_features+num_classes, num_hidden_1)`，即 `Linear(794, 500)`。**拼接与层维度是一对必须同时改的地方**——只改 cat 不改维度（或反之）会直接形状报错。
121	
122	**关键代码三：decoder 的条件拼接**（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L225-L235](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L225-L235)），这段代码做了什么：decoder 收到的不是裸 z，而是 45 维拼接向量——z 管「风格」，one-hot 管「画什么」，两层信息并排进入解码网络：
123	
124	```python
125	def decoder(self, encoded, targets):
126	    onehot_targets = to_onehot(targets, self.num_classes, device)
127	    encoded = torch.cat((encoded, onehot_targets), dim=1)   # [N,35]+[N,10] → [N,45]
128	    x = F.leaky_relu(self.linear_3(encoded))
129	    x = self.linear_4(x)
130	    decoded = torch.sigmoid(x)
131	    return decoded
132	```
133	
134	第一层维度对应 `Linear(num_latent+num_classes, num_hidden_1)` 即 `Linear(45, 500)`（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L201](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L201)）。**decoder 的条件注入是 CVAE 真正的「生成开关」**：训练结束后生成新图像时 encoder 整个退役（u5-l3 讲过它是训练期脚手架），用户能控制的只有喂给 decoder 的 `(z, y)` 两个输入——条件生成能力完全由这处拼接提供。
135	
136	注意 `forward`（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L237-L243](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L237-L243)）的签名是 `forward(self, features, targets)`——**标签成了模型输入的一部分**，这是 CVAE 系列与此前所有模型的显著不同：`model(features, targets)` 而不是 `model(features)`。

173	**答案**：只有 decoder 输入端的注入。生成新图像时只调用 `model.decoder(z, labels)`：encoder（连同它的条件拼接）只在训练期参与；损失端的拼接更是训练期的监督信号，推理时不存在。所以「条件生成能力」最终物化为 decoder 第一层 `Linear(45, 500)` 中那 10 列条件专属权重。

175	**练习 3**：CVAE 的 KL 项为什么可以和 VAE 完全一样，不用改成 \(D_{KL}(q(z|x,y)\,\|\,p(z|y))\)？
176	
177	**答案**：因为本实现选的先验 \(p(z)=N(0,I)\) **不以 y 为条件**——隐变量与标签在先验下独立，\(p(z|y)=p(z)\)，两项写法本就相等。闭式 KL 只取决于 \(q(z|x,y)=N(\mu(x,y),\sigma^2(x,y))\) 的参数与标准正态，公式自然是 \(\frac{1}{2}\sum(\mu^2+\sigma^2-\ln\sigma^2-1)\)。（若实现选条件先验，KL 会随先验形式改变，但本仓库未这样做。）

179	### 4.2 条件解码器：标签是否参与重建损失的两种实现
180	
181	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
182	
183	**条件解码器的第一个分岔**：z 与 one-hot 拼接后进 decoder 是固定动作，问题是 **decoder 该输出什么**。
184	
185	- **变体 A（without out-concat，`ae-cvae_no-out-concat`）**：decoder 输出 784 维纯像素，重建损失就是熟悉的 `BCE(decoded, features)`。标签的作用止步于「给 decoder 提供输入信息」。
186	- **变体 B（with out-concat，`ae-cvae`）**：decoder 最后一层输出 **794** 维——前 784 维照常重建像素，**末尾 10 维额外重建 one-hot 标签本身**；损失目标是 `cat(features, onehot)` 拼成的 794 维向量。相当于给 decoder 加了一个**辅助分类头**：不仅要把图画对，还要能「认出」自己画的是哪个数字。
187	
188	**变体 B 的直觉**：一个把「7」重建得很像的解码过程，理应也能从自己的生成结果里认出 7。强迫 decoder 输出标签，等于给它一个额外的监督信号，促使其内部特征对类别信息更敏感——这是非卷积 CVAE 文献里的常见做法，`ae-cvae` 的说明文字也明确写道本实现「leads to slightly better results」（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L57](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L57)）。
189	
190	**但结论并不普适**。卷积版的说明文字写着**正好相反**的经验：拼接标签导致「substantially poorer results」（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L57](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L57)），所以才有 `ae-cnn-cvae_no-out-concat` 这份姊妹篇。两处源码注释也各自留下了立场：`ae-cvae_no-out-concat` 里被注释掉的损失行旁边写着「Disabled for reconstruction loss as it gives poor results」（[ae-cvae_no-out-concat.ipynb:L797](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae_no-out-concat.ipynb#L797)）。
191	
192	结合 u3-l5 的教训——**单次运行、未对齐训练配方的对比不可轻信**——正确的态度是：把「标签是否进重建损失」当作一个**需要自己做对照实验的超参选择**，两份 notebook 恰好就是现成的 A/B 模板。

194	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
195	
196	两个变体的训练循环都是标准五步，唯一分岔在损失计算：

198	```text
199	for batch in loader:
200	    features 展平/搬 device，targets 搬 device
201	    z_mean, z_log_var, encoded, decoded = model(features, targets)   # 前向
202	    kl = 0.5*(μ² + exp(logσ²) − logσ² − 1).sum()                     # KL（两版相同）
203	    变体A: bce = BCE(decoded[784], features)                         # 目标=纯像素
204	    变体B: x_con = cat(features, onehot); bce = BCE(decoded[794], x_con)
205	    cost = kl + bce
206	    zero_grad → backward → step
207	```

284	### 4.3 卷积版 CVAE：条件注入的通道化改造
285	
286	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
287	
288	全连接版的条件拼接是**向量维**的（784+10）；卷积网络的输入是 4 维张量 \((N, C, H, W)\)，one-hot 拼不进空间维——条件注入必须换一种几何：**把 10 个标签值变成 10 张与输入图像同尺寸的「条件平面」**，沿通道维与图像拼成 11 通道输入。
289	
290	具体做法（源码三步，见 4.3.3）：把 `(N,10)` 的 one-hot 变形为 `(N,10,1,1)`，乘上形状 `(N,10,28,28)` 的全 1 张量——广播把每个标签值铺满整张平面，得到 10 张「全 c 值平面」；再与 1 通道图像 cat。对类别 c，第 c 张条件平面全 1、其余全 0，本质上是 **10 张二值掩码**：卷积核在图像每个位置都能「看到」这是什么类别，条件信息带上了空间结构。
291	
292	decoder 侧对称：`Linear(50+10 → 64·2·2)` 先把条件拼进向量（与全连接版同法），还原成 64×2×2 特征图后经三个转置卷积上采样，**最后一层输出 11 个通道**（1 个图像通道 + 10 个标签通道），对应 4.2 节的变体 B——用通道而非向量维度实现「标签参与重建损失」。
293	
294	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
295	
296	卷积版一次前向的形状链（batch 维省略；encoder 用 u3-l1 的卷积公式 \(o=\lfloor(w-k+2p)/s\rfloor+1\)，decoder 用 u5-l2 的转置卷积公式 \(o=(w-1)s-2p+k\)）：
297	
298	| 段 | 操作 | 形状 |
299	| --- | --- | --- |
300	| 条件平面 | one-hot 广播成掩码 | 10×28×28 |
301	| 拼接 | cat(图像, 掩码, dim=1) | **11**×28×28 |
302	| enc_conv_1 | Conv2d(11→16, k6, s2) | 16×12×12 |
303	| enc_conv_2 | Conv2d(16→32, k4, s2) | 32×5×5 |
304	| enc_conv_3 | Conv2d(32→64, k2, s2) | 64×2×2 |
305	| 双头 | Linear(256→50) ×2 + 重参数化 | 50 |
306	| 拼接 | cat(z, one-hot) | 60 |
307	| dec_linear_1 | Linear(60→256) + reshape | 64×2×2 |
308	| dec_deconv_1 | ConvT(64→32, k2, s2) | 32×4×4 |
309	| dec_deconv_2 | ConvT(32→16, k4, s3, p1) | 16×11×11 |
310	| dec_deconv_3 | ConvT(16→**11**, k6, s3, p4) | **11**×28×28 |
311	
312	逐层验算两处关键尺寸：encoder 末层 \((5-2)/2+1 = 2\)，与 `z_mean` 的输入 `64*2*2`=256 精确匹配；decoder 末层 \((11-1)\cdot3-2\cdot4+6 = 28\)，恰好还原原图尺寸。`num_latent` 从全连接版的 35 提到 50（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L119](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L119)）。
313	
314	参数量按层手工统计合计 **86,927**（如 6352+8224+8256+12850×2+15616+8224+8208+6347），约为全连接版的十分之一——卷积的参数共享优势（u3-l1）在生成模型里同样成立。

318	**关键代码一：入口通道数 +1 变 +11**（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L195-L200](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L195-L200)），这段代码做了什么：第一个卷积层的 `in_channels` 不是 1 而是 `1+self.num_classes`=11，为 10 张条件平面预留输入通道：

322	                                  out_channels=16, kernel_size=(6, 6), stride=(2, 2), padding=0)
323	```
324	
325	**关键代码二：条件平面的广播构造**（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L258-L270](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L258-L270)），这段代码做了什么：encoder 前段的三步条件化——one-hot 变形为 `(N,10,1,1)`、乘全 1 张量广播成 10 张 28×28 掩码、与图像沿通道维拼接：
326	
327	```python
328	onehot_targets = to_onehot(targets, self.num_classes, device)
329	onehot_targets = onehot_targets.view(-1, self.num_classes, 1, 1)   # [N,10]→[N,10,1,1]
330	ones = torch.ones(features.size()[0], self.num_classes,
331	                  features.size()[2], features.size()[3], ...).to(device)  # [N,10,28,28] 全1
332	ones = ones * onehot_targets          # 广播：每张平面填入对应标签值（0或1）
333	x = torch.cat((features, ones), dim=1)  # [N,1,28,28]+[N,10,28,28] → [N,11,28,28]
334	```

336	广播规则（u2-l3 提过）：`(N,10,28,28)` 与 `(N,10,1,1)` 相乘时，后两维自动扩张——**没有复制内存**，每个空间位置共享同一个标签值。

385	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
386	
387	**练习 1**：为什么不把 one-hot 直接 `cat` 到图像张量后面（变成 29 行），而要费劲广播成 10 张平面？
388	
389	**答案**：`Conv2d` 要求输入形状固定为 `(N, C, H, W)`，空间维 H、W 由卷积核几何决定，把 10 个数拼成「第 29 行像素」会破坏这一约定，且这 10 个值会被卷积核当作普通像素滑窗处理、位置语义混乱。通道维才是为「并行的特征平面」设计的维度：10 张常数平面与 1 张图像平面在卷积眼里一视同仁，第一个卷积核的 11 通道权重自然学会「读图 + 读条件」。
390	
391	**练习 2**：卷积版作者报告「标签进重建损失」明显更差（与全连接版结论相反）。给出一个可能的机理猜想。
392	
393	**答案**：一种解释是输出端的**通道不平衡**：11 个输出通道里 10 个是近乎「抄答案」的标签通道（decoder 输入端就有 one-hot），其 BCE 很快趋零；但这些通道与图像通道共享前面的卷积特征，标签通道的梯度会持续把共享特征往「复制 one-hot」的方向拉，挤占了本该用于重建的空间结构学习。全连接版里标签头只占 794 维中的 10 维且经由独立的最后一层权重，干扰相对小。（猜想需实验检验——正好可用 `ae-cnn-cvae_no-out-concat.ipynb` 做对照。）
394	
395	**练习 3**：卷积版的 `num_latent` 是 50，全连接版是 35。隐变量维度不同会影响两版之间的比较吗？
396	
397	**答案**：会影响。两版对比时同时改变了「骨架（全连接 vs 卷积）」与「隐维（35 vs 50）」两个变量，不是严格的受控实验（u2-l4 的「只改一处」原则）。若想干净比较，应把两版的 `num_latent` 对齐再跑——这也是自己做实验时值得注意的细节。

399	### 4.4 按条件采样：从「听天由命」到「指哪打哪」
400	
401	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
402	
403	**生成的全部输入是 `(z, y)`。** 训练结束后，CVAE 的生成流程是：
404	
405	1. 从先验 \(z \sim N(0, I)\) 采样（`torch.randn`）——决定「风格」；
406	2. **手工指定标签 y**——决定「画什么」；
407	3. 只调 `model.decoder(z, y)`，得到图像。
408	
409	对照 u5-l3 的无条件采样：那里 z 独自承担全部信息，采样落点是「哪个数字的领地」纯看运气，还常常落在两类之间的模糊地带；这里 y 直接写在 decoder 输入里，类别**由用户决定**。而 z 的先验依然是无条件标准正态（4.1 讲过），所以采样代码与 u5-l3 几乎相同——只是 decoder 多收一个参数。
410	
411	**「固定 z、遍历 y」是 CVAE 最有说服力的演示**：同一个 z 配上 0–9 十个标签，decoder 应当输出**同一笔迹风格**（粗细、倾斜、饱满程度相近）的十个不同数字。它直观地展示了 y 与 z 的分工——y 换数字、z 保风格——这正是 4.1.1 那个「卸担子」论述的实验证据，也是本讲综合实践的主任务。
412	
413	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
414	
415	notebook 的条件采样循环（每个类别生成一批）：
416	
417	```text
418	for i in 0..9:
419	    labels = tensor([i]*10)             # 10 个相同的标签
420	    z = randn(10, num_latent)           # 10 份先验采样
421	    images = decoder(z, labels)         # 10 张「数字 i」
422	    可视化时掐掉标签维度，只留像素
423	```

425	三份 notebook 的这段代码几乎逐字相同，差异只在「掐标签」的方式：

429	| ae-cvae | `(N, 794)` 向量 | 切片 `[:, :-num_classes]`（掐掉末 10 维） |
430	| ae-cvae_no-out-concat | `(N, 784)` 向量 | 直接用（无标签维可掐） |
431	| ae-cnn-cvae | `(N, 11, 28, 28)` | 切通道 `[:, 0]` |

507	1. **实践目标**：把本讲三个最小模块串成一条链——用 `to_onehot` 的条件接口（4.1）、训练好的条件解码器（4.2）、按条件采样（4.4），产出一组可解释的生成结果。

542	- **CVAE = VAE + 条件拼接**：重参数化、KL + 重建损失、先验采样全部原样继承；新增的只有「把 one-hot 标签拼进 encoder 输入（794/11 通道）与 decoder 输入（45/60）」，模型由此学条件分布 \(p(x|y,z)\)，先验 \(p(z)=N(0,I)\) 不变，故 KL 闭式公式不变。

# 条件变分自编码器 CVAE

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说清楚 **CVAE 与 VAE 的唯一区别**：u5-l3 的 VAE 学的是无条件的 \(p(x|z)\)，采样时「出什么数字全凭运气」；CVAE 把类别标签 y 一起喂进 encoder 和 decoder，学的是**条件分布** \(p(x|y,z)\)，生成时可以**指定要哪个数字**。
2. 理解**标签 one-hot 拼接**这个最朴素的条件化手法：`to_onehot` + `torch.cat` 两行代码，如何把「数字是几」变成网络输入向量里的 10 个维度，以及为什么不能用原始整数标签直接拼。
3. 掌握**条件解码器**的两种实现并加以区分：标签只进 decoder 输入（`ae-cvae_no-out-concat`），还是让 decoder 额外输出 10 维「标签预测头」并参与重建损失（`ae-cvae`）——两种写法只差一层 `Linear` 的输出维度和损失的目标向量。
4. 读懂**卷积版 CVAE**（`ae-cnn-cvae`）：条件从「向量拼接」变成「通道拼接」——10 个 one-hot 值广播成 10 张与输入图像同尺寸的掩码平面，与图像在通道维拼成 11 通道输入；decoder 也对称地输出 11 通道。
5. 会**按条件采样生成**：`torch.randn` 采 z + 手工指定标签 + 只调 `model.decoder(z, labels)`，并完成本讲综合实践——**固定同一个 z、遍历 0–9 十个标签**，观察「同一笔迹风格被渲染成十个不同数字」。

本讲是 u5-l3（VAE）的直接续篇：重参数化、KL + 重建损失、从先验采样这三件 VAE 的核心资产全部原样继承，一行都不用改；新增的只有「条件怎么进网络」这一件事。

## 2. 前置知识

- **VAE 三件套**（u5-l3）：① 重参数化 \(z = \mu + \epsilon\sigma\) 让采样可导；② 损失 = 逐像素 BCE（重建）+ 闭式 KL 项 \(\frac{1}{2}\sum(\mu^2 + \sigma^2 - \ln\sigma^2 - 1)\)；③ 训练后从 \(N(0, I)\) 采样、只喂 decoder 即可生成图像。本讲三份 notebook 的 `reparameterize` 与损失代码与 u5-l3 **逐字相同**。
- **one-hot 编码**：类别标签 7 不是数字 7，而是一个只有第 7 位为 1 的 10 维单位向量 \(e_7\)。u2-l2 里标签以 int64 整数喂给 `cross_entropy`；本讲标签要**作为输入特征**拼进网络，必须先 one-hot 化，原因见 4.1.1。
- **`Tensor.scatter_`**：按索引在指定维度上原地写入值。`labels_onehot.scatter_(1, labels.view(-1,1), 1)` 的语义是：对每一行（dim=0 方向遍历），把 1 写进第 1 维上索引等于该行标签值的那个位置。
- **转置卷积输出尺寸**（u5-l2）：\(o = (w-1)\cdot s - 2p + k\)，卷积版 CVAE 的 decoder 上采样链要用它手工推导。
- **NCHW 与通道维拼接**（u3-l1）：卷积网络输入形状是 \((N, C, H, W)\)，`torch.cat(..., dim=1)` 沿通道维拼接是「给卷积网络加额外输入信息」的标准姿势。
- **五步训练循环**（u2-l2）：forward → loss → `zero_grad` → `backward` → `step`。autoencoder 系列一如既往**不用** helper_train 的共享训练函数（u4-l4），因为损失需要 `z_mean` / `z_log_var`，只能手写循环。
- **读源码两处老坑**（u5-l2、u5-l3 反复出现）：① 三份 notebook 的说明文字都写着「compresses **768-pixel** MNIST images」，实际 28×28=**784**，代码（`num_features = 784`）才是对的；② `ae-cvae` 与 `ae-cvae_no-out-concat` 的 device 写的是 `cuda:1`，**单卡机器会报 invalid device ordinal**，跑之前要改成 `cuda:0`。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

README 的「Conditional Variational Autoencoders」小节（[README.md:L225-L232](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/README.md#L225-L232)）收录了 4 份 CVAE notebook，本讲精读其中 3 份：

| `pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb` | **卷积 CVAE（标签参与重建损失）**：条件通道化注入 + 转置卷积解码，4.3 节主线。 |
| `pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae_no-out-concat.ipynb` | 卷积版「不拼接标签」姊妹篇，本讲不精读，仅作对照存在。 |

三份精读 notebook 的结构总览（超参均完全相同：`random_seed=0`、`learning_rate=0.001`、`num_epochs=50`、`batch_size=128`）：

| decoder 输出 | **794**（784 像素 + 10 标签头） | **784**（纯像素） | **11×28×28**（1 图像通道 + 10 标签通道） |
| 重建损失目标 | `x_con = cat(features, onehot)` | `features` | `x_con = cat(features, 条件平面)` |
| `num_latent` | 35 | 35 | 50 |
| 参数量（按层定义手工统计） | 853,364 | 848,354 | 86,927 |
| 首个 batch 损失（作者日志） | 71038.59 | 70192.22 | 767976.69 |
| 第 50 epoch 末段损失（作者日志） | ≈12278.76 | ≈12618.78 | ≈22728.79 |

> **行号说明**：本讲所有永久链接指向 `.ipynb` 原始 JSON 文件的行号（GitHub 上打开即命中对应行）。
>
> 两点提醒：① 损失数值**跨行不可直接比**——输出维度不同（794 vs 784 vs 11×28×28=8624 个 BCE 目标），只有同列内纵向看下降趋势才有意义；② 卷积版每个样本要重建 8624 个目标，所以首个 batch 损失比全连接版大一个数量级是维度差异，不代表更差。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 标签 one-hot 拼接：条件信息的三处注入

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

**从 VAE 的一个遗憾讲起。** u5-l3 的 VAE 从先验采样时，z 里必须**同时**编码「这是哪个数字」和「这个数字长什么样（粗细、倾斜、连笔）」两类信息。但 KL 项又在不遗余力地把所有编码拉向 \(N(0,I)\)——它并不知道「1 和 7 是不同的类别」，只会把不同数字的编码在隐空间里压到一起。结果就是无条件采样经常得到笔画含混、介于两个数字之间的图像。

**CVAE 的思路：类别信息不劳 z 编码，直接告诉网络。** 我们真正想学的生成模型从 \(p(x)\) 升级为**条件生成模型** \(p_\theta(x \mid y)\)——「给定标签 y（比如 7），生成一张 7 的图像」。按生成过程 \(y \to z \to x\) 分解，推断与生成两侧各加一个条件：

\[ \text{推断（encoder）：} q_\phi(z \mid x, y) \qquad \text{生成（decoder）：} p_\theta(x \mid y, z) \]

对应的条件 ELBO（与 u5-l3 的无条件版本逐项对照，只是各多了个 \(y\)）：

\[ \log p_\theta(x \mid y) \;\ge\; \mathbb{E}_{q_\phi(z|x,y)}\big[\log p_\theta(x|y,z)\big] \;-\; D_{KL}\big(q_\phi(z|x,y)\,\|\,p(z)\big) \]

注意一个关键事实：**本实现里先验 \(p(z)=N(0,I)\) 不以 y 为条件**（标签信息既不进 KL 项也不进采样），所以 KL 项的闭式公式与 u5-l3 **一字不差**。条件的全部作用都通过「拼接进网络输入」实现。

**分工的直觉**：y 负责「画什么」，z 只负责「怎么画」。类间差异这副重担从 z 身上卸下后，z 只需在**类内**描述笔迹风格，KL 项也不再有机会把不同类别的编码糊在一起——这就是 CVAE 生成的数字通常比 VAE 更清晰的原因。

**为什么必须 one-hot 而不能直接拼整数标签？** `Linear` 层的输入是一个向量，第 i 个维度乘的是权重矩阵第 i 行。如果直接把标签 7 以数值 7 拼进去：① 数值大小暗示了「7 号类比 1 号类大 7 倍」这种**人为的序关系与量纲**，MNIST 类别之间并无此关系；② 一个标量只占一个输入维度，信息容量太小。one-hot 把类别 c 变成单位向量 \(e_c\)：各类别两两正交（无虚假序关系）、各占一个专属输入维度（各配一列专属权重），是最干净的做法。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

条件在**三个位置**注入（`ae-cvae` 为例）：

```text
标签 y (int64, 形状 [N])
   │ to_onehot → onehot (float32, 形状 [N,10])
   │
   ├──① encoder 输入端：cat(features 784, onehot 10) → 794 维 ─→ q(z|x,y)
   │
   ├──② decoder 输入端：cat(z 35, onehot 10) → 45 维 ─→ p(x|y,z)
   │
   └──③ 重建损失目标端（仅 out-concat 版）：cat(features, onehot) = 794 维目标
                                                        （见 4.2）
```

one-hot 的构造只有三行：建全零张量 → `scatter_` 按标签位置写 1 → 返回。它在**模型外**定义成自由函数，模型内部与训练循环各调用一次。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**关键代码一：`to_onehot` 工具函数**（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L172-L178](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L172-L178)），这段代码做了什么：把 int64 标签批量转成 one-hot 浮点矩阵——先建 `(N, 10)` 全零张量搬到 device，再用 `scatter_` 把每行第「标签值」列写成 1：

```python
def to_onehot(labels, num_classes, device):
    labels_onehot = torch.zeros(labels.size()[0], num_classes).to(device)
    labels_onehot.scatter_(1, labels.view(-1, 1), 1)
    return labels_onehot
```

两个细节：① `labels.view(-1, 1)` 把形状 `(N,)` 变成 `(N, 1)`——`scatter_` 沿 dim=1 写入时要求索引张量与源张量形状一致，每行一个标量索引；② 它是**模块级函数而非模型方法**（三份 notebook 均如此，如 [ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L171-L177](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L171-L177)），所以训练循环里算损失时也能直接调它。

**关键代码二：encoder 的条件拼接**（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L212-L223](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L212-L223)），这段代码做了什么：`encoder` 开头两行就是「条件化」——one-hot 后与展平的像素向量沿特征维 cat 成 794 维，其余（隐层→双头→重参数化）与 u5-l3 的 VAE 完全相同：

```python
def encoder(self, features, targets):
    ### Add condition
    onehot_targets = to_onehot(targets, self.num_classes, device)
    x = torch.cat((features, onehot_targets), dim=1)   # [N,784] + [N,10] → [N,794]
    x = F.leaky_relu(self.hidden_1(x))
    z_mean = self.z_mean(x)
    z_log_var = self.z_log_var(x)
    encoded = self.reparameterize(z_mean, z_log_var)
    return z_mean, z_log_var, encoded
```

对应地，第一层的输入维度在 `__init__` 里就是 `num_features+num_classes`（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L188](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L188)）：`torch.nn.Linear(num_features+num_classes, num_hidden_1)`，即 `Linear(794, 500)`。**拼接与层维度是一对必须同时改的地方**——只改 cat 不改维度（或反之）会直接形状报错。

**关键代码三：decoder 的条件拼接**（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L225-L235](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L225-L235)），这段代码做了什么：decoder 收到的不是裸 z，而是 45 维拼接向量——z 管「风格」，one-hot 管「画什么」，两层信息并排进入解码网络：

```python
def decoder(self, encoded, targets):
    onehot_targets = to_onehot(targets, self.num_classes, device)
    encoded = torch.cat((encoded, onehot_targets), dim=1)   # [N,35]+[N,10] → [N,45]
    x = F.leaky_relu(self.linear_3(encoded))
    x = self.linear_4(x)
    decoded = torch.sigmoid(x)
    return decoded
```

第一层维度对应 `Linear(num_latent+num_classes, num_hidden_1)` 即 `Linear(45, 500)`（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L201](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L201)）。**decoder 的条件注入是 CVAE 真正的「生成开关」**：训练结束后生成新图像时 encoder 整个退役（u5-l3 讲过它是训练期脚手架），用户能控制的只有喂给 decoder 的 `(z, y)` 两个输入——条件生成能力完全由这处拼接提供。

注意 `forward`（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L237-L243](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L237-L243)）的签名是 `forward(self, features, targets)`——**标签成了模型输入的一部分**，这是 CVAE 系列与此前所有模型的显著不同：`model(features, targets)` 而不是 `model(features)`。

**练习 1**：如果把标签直接以 `targets.float()`（取值 0–9 的标量列）拼在 784 维像素后面，会发生什么？

**练习 2**：条件注入了 encoder、decoder、（下节的）损失三处。哪一处是「生成时仍然起作用」的？

**答案**：只有 decoder 输入端的注入。生成新图像时只调用 `model.decoder(z, labels)`：encoder（连同它的条件拼接）只在训练期参与；损失端的拼接更是训练期的监督信号，推理时不存在。所以「条件生成能力」最终物化为 decoder 第一层 `Linear(45, 500)` 中那 10 列条件专属权重。

**练习 3**：CVAE 的 KL 项为什么可以和 VAE 完全一样，不用改成 \(D_{KL}(q(z|x,y)\,\|\,p(z|y))\)？

**答案**：因为本实现选的先验 \(p(z)=N(0,I)\) **不以 y 为条件**——隐变量与标签在先验下独立，\(p(z|y)=p(z)\)，两项写法本就相等。闭式 KL 只取决于 \(q(z|x,y)=N(\mu(x,y),\sigma^2(x,y))\) 的参数与标准正态，公式自然是 \(\frac{1}{2}\sum(\mu^2+\sigma^2-\ln\sigma^2-1)\)。（若实现选条件先验，KL 会随先验形式改变，但本仓库未这样做。）

### 4.2 条件解码器：标签是否参与重建损失的两种实现

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

**条件解码器的第一个分岔**：z 与 one-hot 拼接后进 decoder 是固定动作，问题是 **decoder 该输出什么**。

- **变体 A（without out-concat，`ae-cvae_no-out-concat`）**：decoder 输出 784 维纯像素，重建损失就是熟悉的 `BCE(decoded, features)`。标签的作用止步于「给 decoder 提供输入信息」。
- **变体 B（with out-concat，`ae-cvae`）**：decoder 最后一层输出 **794** 维——前 784 维照常重建像素，**末尾 10 维额外重建 one-hot 标签本身**；损失目标是 `cat(features, onehot)` 拼成的 794 维向量。相当于给 decoder 加了一个**辅助分类头**：不仅要把图画对，还要能「认出」自己画的是哪个数字。

**变体 B 的直觉**：一个把「7」重建得很像的解码过程，理应也能从自己的生成结果里认出 7。强迫 decoder 输出标签，等于给它一个额外的监督信号，促使其内部特征对类别信息更敏感——这是非卷积 CVAE 文献里的常见做法，`ae-cvae` 的说明文字也明确写道本实现「leads to slightly better results」（[ae-cvae.ipynb:L57](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae.ipynb#L57)）。

**但结论并不普适**。卷积版的说明文字写着**正好相反**的经验：拼接标签导致「substantially poorer results」（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L57](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L57)），所以才有 `ae-cnn-cvae_no-out-concat` 这份姊妹篇。两处源码注释也各自留下了立场：`ae-cvae_no-out-concat` 里被注释掉的损失行旁边写着「Disabled for reconstruction loss as it gives poor results」（[ae-cvae_no-out-concat.ipynb:L797](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cvae_no-out-concat.ipynb#L797)）。

结合 u3-l5 的教训——**单次运行、未对齐训练配方的对比不可轻信**——正确的态度是：把「标签是否进重建损失」当作一个**需要自己做对照实验的超参选择**，两份 notebook 恰好就是现成的 A/B 模板。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

两个变体的训练循环都是标准五步，唯一分岔在损失计算：

```text
for batch in loader:
    features 展平/搬 device，targets 搬 device
    z_mean, z_log_var, encoded, decoded = model(features, targets)   # 前向
    kl = 0.5*(μ² + exp(logσ²) − logσ² − 1).sum()                     # KL（两版相同）
    变体A: bce = BCE(decoded[784], features)                         # 目标=纯像素
    变体B: x_con = cat(features, onehot); bce = BCE(decoded[794], x_con)
    cost = kl + bce
    zero_grad → backward → step
```

注意 BCE 与 KL 都用 `reduction='sum'`：对 batch 内所有样本、所有输出维度求和。这让损失数值随 batch 大小与输出维度变化（解释了总览表中三列损失不可横向比），但梯度方向不受均值化的「小批权重放大」问题影响（u4-l4 讲过 epoch 聚合时同样先用 sum 再除样本数的思想）。

### 4.3 卷积版 CVAE：条件注入的通道化改造

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

全连接版的条件拼接是**向量维**的（784+10）；卷积网络的输入是 4 维张量 \((N, C, H, W)\)，one-hot 拼不进空间维——条件注入必须换一种几何：**把 10 个标签值变成 10 张与输入图像同尺寸的「条件平面」**，沿通道维与图像拼成 11 通道输入。

具体做法（源码三步，见 4.3.3）：把 `(N,10)` 的 one-hot 变形为 `(N,10,1,1)`，乘上形状 `(N,10,28,28)` 的全 1 张量——广播把每个标签值铺满整张平面，得到 10 张「全 c 值平面」；再与 1 通道图像 cat。对类别 c，第 c 张条件平面全 1、其余全 0，本质上是 **10 张二值掩码**：卷积核在图像每个位置都能「看到」这是什么类别，条件信息带上了空间结构。

decoder 侧对称：`Linear(50+10 → 64·2·2)` 先把条件拼进向量（与全连接版同法），还原成 64×2×2 特征图后经三个转置卷积上采样，**最后一层输出 11 个通道**（1 个图像通道 + 10 个标签通道），对应 4.2 节的变体 B——用通道而非向量维度实现「标签参与重建损失」。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

卷积版一次前向的形状链（batch 维省略；encoder 用 u3-l1 的卷积公式 \(o=\lfloor(w-k+2p)/s\rfloor+1\)，decoder 用 u5-l2 的转置卷积公式 \(o=(w-1)s-2p+k\)）：

| 段 | 操作 | 形状 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 条件平面 | one-hot 广播成掩码 | 10×28×28 |
| 拼接 | cat(图像, 掩码, dim=1) | **11**×28×28 |
| enc_conv_1 | Conv2d(11→16, k6, s2) | 16×12×12 |
| enc_conv_2 | Conv2d(16→32, k4, s2) | 32×5×5 |
| enc_conv_3 | Conv2d(32→64, k2, s2) | 64×2×2 |
| 双头 | Linear(256→50) ×2 + 重参数化 | 50 |
| 拼接 | cat(z, one-hot) | 60 |
| dec_linear_1 | Linear(60→256) + reshape | 64×2×2 |
| dec_deconv_1 | ConvT(64→32, k2, s2) | 32×4×4 |
| dec_deconv_2 | ConvT(32→16, k4, s3, p1) | 16×11×11 |
| dec_deconv_3 | ConvT(16→**11**, k6, s3, p4) | **11**×28×28 |

逐层验算两处关键尺寸：encoder 末层 \((5-2)/2+1 = 2\)，与 `z_mean` 的输入 `64*2*2`=256 精确匹配；decoder 末层 \((11-1)\cdot3-2\cdot4+6 = 28\)，恰好还原原图尺寸。`num_latent` 从全连接版的 35 提到 50（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L119](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L119)）。

参数量按层手工统计合计 **86,927**（如 6352+8224+8256+12850×2+15616+8224+8208+6347），约为全连接版的十分之一——卷积的参数共享优势（u3-l1）在生成模型里同样成立。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

```python

```

**关键代码二：条件平面的广播构造**（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L258-L270](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L258-L270)），这段代码做了什么：encoder 前段的三步条件化——one-hot 变形为 `(N,10,1,1)`、乘全 1 张量广播成 10 张 28×28 掩码、与图像沿通道维拼接：

```python
onehot_targets = to_onehot(targets, self.num_classes, device)
onehot_targets = onehot_targets.view(-1, self.num_classes, 1, 1)   # [N,10]→[N,10,1,1]

                  features.size()[2], features.size()[3], ...).to(device)  # [N,10,28,28] 全1
ones = ones * onehot_targets          # 广播：每张平面填入对应标签值（0或1）
x = torch.cat((features, ones), dim=1)  # [N,1,28,28]+[N,10,28,28] → [N,11,28,28]
```

广播规则（u2-l3 提过）：`(N,10,28,28)` 与 `(N,10,1,1)` 相乘时，后两维自动扩张——**没有复制内存**，每个空间位置共享同一个标签值。

**关键代码三：出口 11 通道**（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L243-L247](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L243-L247)），这段代码做了什么：decoder 最后一个转置卷积输出 11 通道——通道 0 是重建图像，通道 1–10 对应 one-hot 的 10 个标签位，是 4.2 节变体 B 的通道版：

```python
self.dec_deconv_3 = torch.nn.ConvTranspose2d(in_channels=16,
                                             out_channels=11,   # 1 图像 + 10 标签
                                             kernel_size=(6, 6), stride=(3, 3), padding=4)
```

**关键代码四：训练损失的同构改造**（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L917-L936](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L917-L936)），这段代码做了什么：训练循环里把 4.3.3 关键代码二的三步原样重演一遍构造 11 通道目标 `x_con`，再对 decoder 的 11 通道输出做逐通道 BCE；KL 项依旧原封不动：

```python

ones = ones * onehot_targets
x_con = torch.cat((features, ones), dim=1)          # 11×28×28 的目标
pixelwise_bce = F.binary_cross_entropy(decoded, x_con, reduction='sum')
cost = kl_divergence + pixelwise_bce
```

**关键代码五：可视化只取通道 0**（[ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb:L1000](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/autoencoder/ae-cnn-cvae.ipynb#L1000)），这段代码做了什么：重建展示时用 `decoded[:n_images, 0]` 切出图像通道、丢弃 10 个标签通道——通道维上的「掐头」与全连接版向量维上的 `[:, :-num_classes]`（4.4 节）是同一个动作的两种几何。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么不把 one-hot 直接 `cat` 到图像张量后面（变成 29 行），而要费劲广播成 10 张平面？

**答案**：`Conv2d` 要求输入形状固定为 `(N, C, H, W)`，空间维 H、W 由卷积核几何决定，把 10 个数拼成「第 29 行像素」会破坏这一约定，且这 10 个值会被卷积核当作普通像素滑窗处理、位置语义混乱。通道维才是为「并行的特征平面」设计的维度：10 张常数平面与 1 张图像平面在卷积眼里一视同仁，第一个卷积核的 11 通道权重自然学会「读图 + 读条件」。

**练习 2**：卷积版作者报告「标签进重建损失」明显更差（与全连接版结论相反）。给出一个可能的机理猜想。

**答案**：一种解释是输出端的**通道不平衡**：11 个输出通道里 10 个是近乎「抄答案」的标签通道（decoder 输入端就有 one-hot），其 BCE 很快趋零；但这些通道与图像通道共享前面的卷积特征，标签通道的梯度会持续把共享特征往「复制 one-hot」的方向拉，挤占了本该用于重建的空间结构学习。全连接版里标签头只占 794 维中的 10 维且经由独立的最后一层权重，干扰相对小。（猜想需实验检验——正好可用 `ae-cnn-cvae_no-out-concat.ipynb` 做对照。）

**练习 3**：卷积版的 `num_latent` 是 50，全连接版是 35。隐变量维度不同会影响两版之间的比较吗？

**答案**：会影响。两版对比时同时改变了「骨架（全连接 vs 卷积）」与「隐维（35 vs 50）」两个变量，不是严格的受控实验（u2-l4 的「只改一处」原则）。若想干净比较，应把两版的 `num_latent` 对齐再跑——这也是自己做实验时值得注意的细节。

### 4.4 按条件采样：从「听天由命」到「指哪打哪」

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

**生成的全部输入是 `(z, y)`。** 训练结束后，CVAE 的生成流程是：

1. 从先验 \(z \sim N(0, I)\) 采样（`torch.randn`）——决定「风格」；
2. **手工指定标签 y**——决定「画什么」；
3. 只调 `model.decoder(z, y)`，得到图像。

对照 u5-l3 的无条件采样：那里 z 独自承担全部信息，采样落点是「哪个数字的领地」纯看运气，还常常落在两类之间的模糊地带；这里 y 直接写在 decoder 输入里，类别**由用户决定**。而 z 的先验依然是无条件标准正态（4.1 讲过），所以采样代码与 u5-l3 几乎相同——只是 decoder 多收一个参数。

**「固定 z、遍历 y」是 CVAE 最有说服力的演示**：同一个 z 配上 0–9 十个标签，decoder 应当输出**同一笔迹风格**（粗细、倾斜、饱满程度相近）的十个不同数字。它直观地展示了 y 与 z 的分工——y 换数字、z 保风格——这正是 4.1.1 那个「卸担子」论述的实验证据，也是本讲综合实践的主任务。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

notebook 的条件采样循环（每个类别生成一批）：

```text
for i in 0..9:
    labels = tensor([i]*10)             # 10 个相同的标签
    z = randn(10, num_latent)           # 10 份先验采样
    images = decoder(z, labels)         # 10 张「数字 i」
    可视化时掐掉标签维度，只留像素
```

三份 notebook 的这段代码几乎逐字相同，差异只在「掐标签」的方式：

| notebook | decoder 输出 | 取图像的方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ae-cvae | `(N, 794)` 向量 | 切片 `[:, :-num_classes]`（掐掉末 10 维） |
| ae-cvae_no-out-concat | `(N, 784)` 向量 | 直接用（无标签维可掐） |
| ae-cnn-cvae | `(N, 11, 28, 28)` | 切通道 `[:, 0]` |

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：生成时如果不传标签、随便喂一个全零的 `targets` 张量（one-hot 全 0），会发生什么？

**答案**：不会报错——`to_onehot` 对全零标签产出全 0 的 one-hot（scatter 没有位置可写 1），decoder 照常解码，只是条件输入退化成「什么类别都不是」。输出大概率是模糊、无明确类别的图像，因为训练时从未见过这种「非法条件」。这提示：**条件生成模型对条件输入的合法性有隐含约定**。

**练习 2**：想用训练好的 CVAE 做「把 3 改写成 8」的风格迁移式编辑，最小可行做法是什么？

**答案**：用 encoder 把真实的 3 编码成 z（取 `z_mean` 更稳定，u5-l3 讲过 `encoded` 带采样噪声），再把**同一个 z 配上标签 8** 交给 decoder：`z, _, _ = model.encoder(x3, torch.tensor([3])); out = model.decoder(z, torch.tensor([8]))`。前提正是本讲的分工假设——z 里主要剩风格信息、类别由 y 承载。效果是否如意待本地验证。

**练习 3**：为什么生成代码用 `torch.randn` 而不是把训练集编码的 z 拿来复用？

**答案**：两种都能生成，含义不同。`randn` 采的是**先验**里的点，检验的是「KL 项把隐空间整理成标准正态」的承诺兑现程度（u5-l3 的核心论点）；复用编码 z 则是「重建/编辑」场景（练习 2），检验的是条件解码的保真度。notebook 选择前者，是为了展示模型作为**生成模型**的能力——这也是 CVAE 与 u5-l1 普通 AE 的本质分界。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **CVAE = VAE + 条件拼接**：重参数化、KL + 重建损失、先验采样全部原样继承；新增的只有「把 one-hot 标签拼进 encoder 输入（794/11 通道）与 decoder 输入（45/60）」，模型由此学条件分布 \(p(x|y,z)\)，先验 \(p(z)=N(0,I)\) 不变，故 KL 闭式公式不变。
- **标签 one-hot 拼接**：`to_onehot` 用 `zeros + scatter_` 三行实现，类别间正交、各占一个专属输入维度；标签从「监督信号」升级为「模型输入的一部分」，`forward(features, targets)` 的签名变化是外在标志。

- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }

  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.
